name: Akihito's mother
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c19116]Akihito[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c11964]Umi[/url]'s mother.

Kind and very attentive to the needs of her children. Umi calls her once every weeks and she complains a lot that her son never calls her on his own initiative. She has a good relationship with [url=https://vndb.org/c11966]Yuika[/url] whom she considers as her own daughter.
